cases.prompt: Review release candidate v4.2.0 (commit b7e21c4, image sha256:9c0e7a51d3b2). It changes the payment-provider configuration (new webhook secret read from PAYMENTS_WEBHOOK_SECRET) and adds migration 0063, which drops the column payments.legacy_ref. Required checks: unit and integration green on b7e21c4; no check exercises webhooks with the new secret. Rollout sequence: 1. run migration 0063, 2. deploy v4.2.0 to 10% then 100% over one hour, 3. set PAYMENTS_WEBHOOK_SECRET in production. Alert thresholds: webhook failures > 5% for 10 minutes. Rollback plan: redeploy v4.1.3; v4.1.3 still reads payments.legacy_ref.
sourceAnchors: exact release revision or immutable artifact identity

forbiddenClaims: the release is ready to ship
